Our Mascot

Who We Are

Fierce. Exclusive.
Unapologetically Free.

Like the tiger: powerful, selective, and impossible to ignore. Paco Revolution is a sanctuary for those who love without limits and live without apology.

You've outgrown the
ordinary.
So have we.

Paco Revolution is not a dating app. It's a living, breathing community, built for those who embrace polyamory, ethical non-monogamy, open relationships, and every constellation in between.

We believe in radical inclusivity. All genders, all orientations, all relationship structures. Singles, couples, throuples, and everyone who doesn't fit a label.

What we don't believe in: judgment, gatekeeping, or settling. Membership is earned. Events are curated. The experience is yours.

What We Stand For

Built on Three Pillars

01

Exclusivity

This is not a space for everyone. It's a space for people who are intentional about connection. Membership is curated, not mass-marketed. The people you meet here are here for the same reasons you are.

02

Radical Inclusion

Polyamorous, swinger, queer, ENM-curious, kinky, vanilla, your lifestyle is welcome here. We build spaces where every configuration of love and connection is not just tolerated, but celebrated.

03

Real Community

Champagne socials at Flûte. Mansion parties at Dery House. IRL events engineered for actual connection. The app is the map. The events are the destination.

Flagship Event

Mansion Soirée

Private mansion. 100 couples. Black card entry. Five times a year: NYE, Valentine's Day, Memorial Day, July 4th, Halloween. This is where Paco members come home.

Champagne Munch
